text:
**B**

Both responses exceed the 120-word limit. A is roughly 260 words, about double the cap. B is roughly 130 words, only slightly over.

B is better suited to a busy manager. Its bolded bullet headings are easy to skim, and it keeps all the key details: time, venue, agenda, prep, food deadline, out-of-office arrangements and the optional drinks.

A reads as a rewritten email rather than a summary. It even slips into Hannah's first-person voice ("I would kindly ask"), which is inappropriate when the manager is the reader.
